name: chart-bar-02
title: chart-bar-02
description: Monthly orders · online and in store. Online contributed 57.5% of June orders.

meta.prompt:
Create a responsive analytics card titled “Sales by channel” with the muted eyebrow “Monthly orders · online and in store”. Fill available width up to 576px. Use a theme-aware card surface, rounded border, an 18px title, a prominent 30px semibold metric with tabular numerals, and a separated muted footer.

Plot grouped bars for Online and In store orders from Jan–Jun, respectively 186, 225, 208, 284, 312, 368 and 140, 178, 190, 210, 245, 272. Use distinct chart colors, rounded top corners, and a legend. Show 640 orders and note that online contributed 57.5% of June orders.

Keep the plot 260px tall and responsive to the card width. Provide accessible chart navigation and value tooltips. Use Jan–Jun month labels, a numeric vertical axis, subtle horizontal grid lines, and muted axis labels and baselines.

Build the chart with TanStack Charts. Use responsive chart geometry, theme-aware chart colors, a labeled legend, and pointer and keyboard value tooltips.
